title: BrakeRequest
description: The input of control.suspend and control.lift: the brake's target, and the person's reason, which the log keeps (step 25b's README, decisions D1 and D2). This tutorial's own schema: the specification names no operation that pulls or lifts a brake. The target is one agent of the company, dsor://org_456/agent/accounts-payable-fte, or the company itself, dsor://org_456/tenant/org_456, so every agent of it. The pattern is the specification's resourceUri; the /agent/ and /tenant/ parts beside it are this tutorial's.

reason.description: Why the brake is pulled or lifted, in the person's own words, for the people who read the log.
